Q: MatIconModule import/export A:

Seems to be fix with Angular 5. Now, you must import MatIconModule.

Q: Hibernate @Where annotation on a ManyToOne relation A:

As you already discovered, or simply use cases the @Where clause is just fine, but in your case, you want to filter PlaceTag by the place and tag too, so a joined is required in this situation.

So, you can keep the @Where clause for Place and Tag, while for PlaceTags you need to use a JPQL query:

select pt
from PlaceTag pt
join pt.tag t
join pt.place p
where 
    t.state='ACTIVE' and p.state='ACTIVE'

At least until @WhereJoinTable annotation is made to work for many-to-one associations too.

Q: IntelliJ/AndroidStudio: icon_banner_image.xml Not Found (Snap) A:

I'm using JetBrains Toolbox App on Linux and I have the same issue. I managed to find a work-around:

Let $idea-dir be the installation directory of you IntelliJ IDEA, for example /home/me/.cache/JetBrains/RemoteDev/dist/f2f855a6d1be7_ideaIU-2024.3.5.

The $idea-dir/plugins directory seems to contain all installed plugins. But for me, there was no directory called android (the "Android" plugin) even though the plugin is installed. So I did the following:

  1. Download the "Android" plugin from JetBrains Marketplace (e.g. android-262.8665.337.zip). Choose the same version as you have installed in your IntelliJ IDEA
  2. Extract the zip archive. It contains a directory called "android".
  3. Copy the "android" directory into $idea-dir/plugins.

Now, the Asset studio wizard works, but I'm not sure if it breaks anything else. Do at your own risk!
